title: The Inhibitory Effect of Peptide Hydrolysate of Type I Collagen Derived from Pig Skin on Melanogenesis in B16F10 Melanoma Cells.
authors: Zheng, Jialin; Xu, Dandan; Li, Tianduo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究猪皮I型胶原肽对黑色素生成的抑制效应，涉及酪氨酸酶活性与黑色素含量，但体系为细胞与斑马鱼色素沉积，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Collagen peptides, as a natural source of peptides, possess multiple advantages such as anti-aging, anti-inflammatory properties, tissue repair, and the ability to inhibit melanin production. In this study, type I collagen extracted from pig skin was hydrolyzed with 1% and 3% hydrochloric acid, yielding collagen peptides CPH1 and CPH3. The melanin content and tyrosinase activity in B16F10 cells were compared via direct and paracrine action when CPH1 and CPH3 were used to interfere with melanogenesis. It was found that CPH3 significantly inhibited melanogenesis in B16F10 through the paracrine action involving HaCaT keratinocytes. The intracellular melanin content was measured at 65.23 +/- 1.30%, and the mRNA levels of tyrosinase and microphthalmia transcription factor in cells were 55.77 +/- 6.09% and 50.70 +/- 8.18% of the negative control, respectively. Furthermore, pigment deposition assays in zebrafish showed that, at a concentration of 1.0 mg/mL, CPH3 significantly inhibited melanogenesis compared to the negative control. Finally, tyrosinase inhibitory peptides were identified from CPH3 through peptide segment sequence identification and molecular dynamics simulation. The peptides of Nona-AGPPGFPGA, Octa-APGPVGPA, and Octa-GLPGPPGP have a double effect on the inhibition of tyrosinase and melanin content in B16F10 cells.
abstract_zh: 胶原蛋白肽作为一种天然肽源，具有抗衰老、抗炎、组织修复及抑制黑色素生成等多重优势。本研究以猪皮提取的I型胶原蛋白为原料，分别用1%和3%盐酸水解，获得胶原蛋白肽CPH1和CPH3。通过直接作用和旁分泌作用两种方式，比较CPH1和CPH3干预黑色素生成时B16F10细胞中的黑色素含量及酪氨酸酶活性。结果发现，CPH3通过涉及HaCaT角质形成细胞的旁分泌作用显著抑制B16F10中的黑色素生成，细胞内黑色素含量测定为65.23 ± 1.30%，细胞中酪氨酸酶及小眼畸形相关转录因子的mRNA水平分别为阴性对照的55.77 ± 6.09%和50.70 ± 8.18%。此外，斑马鱼色素沉积实验表明，在1.0 mg/mL浓度下，与阴性对照相比，CPH3显著抑制黑色素生成。最后，通过肽段序列鉴定和分子动力学模拟，从CPH3中鉴定出酪氨酸酶抑制肽。肽段Nona-AGPPGFPGA、Octa-APGPVGPA和Octa-GLPGPPGP对B16F10细胞中酪氨酸酶活性及黑色素含量具有双重抑制作用。
